No second implementation or TEST-only product exception is necessary.

Catalog construction retains that value and label; selector hydration already recognizes SDK catalogs. Exact offered native values survive existing labels and normalization. Unoffered curated aliases are not added to a nonempty native catalog.

Hidden rows are excluded from catalog options. Explicitly unavailable visible rows remain disabled options, are excluded from available-model enumeration, and fail normalization/selection. Unknown/nonmember values remain refused. The revised R1 correctly separates no visible nonempty rows from a nonempty all-unavailable list: the latter has no static fallback.

Catalog absence, explicit catalog status unavailable, or no visible nonempty launch-model/id rows retains prior fallback. This does not establish authentication, fresh launch readiness, successful model execution or native custody.
